author: ArchaeoPhD Core Team
model_update_policy: Decoupled Architecture: Routine software updates NEVER re-download model weights (10 MB app-only download). Existing 4.5 GB neural weights in Zone 3 are preserved permanently unless a breakthrough fine-tune is explicitly flagged.
durability_invariant: 100% Zero-Data-Loss In-Place Update. User research files, PDFs, thesis chapters, and chat dialogues in Zone 2 Research Vault are never modified or purged.

tier_1_bootstrap.title: Smart Web Installer (Recommended)
tier_1_bootstrap.behavior: Instant download. Installs C++ vector client and native GUI. Features in-place atomic updates and auto-cleans old caches without touching user PDFs.

tier_2_airgapped.title: Air-Gapped Fieldwork Archive (Offline Sites)
tier_2_airgapped.behavior: All-in-one standalone package pre-bundled with 7B LLM weights and embeddings. Designed for remote archaeological excavations, desert field surveys, and laboratory air-gapped workstations without internet.

version_history.title: Archaeological Workspace Decoupling & Bengal Dataset Integration
highlights: Archaeological Project Workspace decoupled from researcher personal profile with scoped domain views
Chandraketugarh Bengal early historic excavation dataset & 7-period Harris matrix chronology
Fixed runtime bulkCreate database interface preventing batch ingestion crashes
Strict project data scoping eliminating cross-workspace entity leakage
Resilient multi-layer client router with explicit workspace action dispatches

version_history.title: ArchaeoPhD Desktop — Initial Doctoral Research Workstation

Local Qwen 2.5 7B LLM reasoning & Nomic 128-dim Matryoshka vector retrieval
Lossless Zstandard monograph PDF ingestion with pre-trained archaeological dictionary
Two-tier Data Root pointer architecture protecting research data from cloud sync leakage
